title: Exploring Parkinson's Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: arXiv:2611.23248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, machine learning (ML) techniques have emerged as promising tools for accurate and timely diagnosis of Parkinson's disease (PD) which is an incurable neurodegenerative disorder. This study explores the integration of ML algorithms and PD diagnosis, highlighting their potential applications in various aspects of the disease. ML methods such as support vector machines, decision trees, multilayer perceptron, k-nearest neighbours, logistic regression and random forest (with and without particle swarm optimisation) were applied on a PD dataset obtained from Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust containing data from 58 people. In terms of accuracy, the Decision Tree and Logistic Regression performed the best with scores of 72-76% while multilayer perceptron was least effective. translated_title: 利用机器学习技术探索帕金森病的诊断
translated_abstract: 近年来，机器学习（ML）技术已成为准确且及时诊断帕金森病（PD）——一种无法治愈的神经退行性疾病——的有前景的工具。本研究探讨了机器学习算法与帕金森病诊断的结合，重点展示了其在疾病各方面的潜在应用。研究将支持向量机、决策树、多层感知器、k近邻、逻辑回归以及随机森林（分别使用和不使用粒子群优化）等机器学习方法应用于从利兹教学医院NHS信托机构获得的一个包含58人数据的帕金森病数据集。在准确率方面，决策树和逻辑回归表现最佳，准确率为72-76%，而多层感知器效果最差。所有模型在分类阳性帕金森病例方面表现出色，灵敏度得分高达97.56%，其中支持向量机分类器表现最优。然而……
tldr: 该研究将多种机器学习算法应用于包含58名患者的帕金森病数据集，发现决策树和逻辑回归准确率最高（72-76%），而支持向量机在识别阳性病例方面灵敏度最优（高达97.56%）。
en_tdlr: This study applied multiple machine learning algorithms to a Parkinson's disease dataset of 58 individuals, finding that Decision Tree and Logistic Regression achieved the best accuracy (72-76%), while the SVM classifier showed the highest sensitivity (up to 97.56%) in classifying positive PD cases.
